name: Complex Micro Interconnection Co.,Ltd.
summary: Complex Micro Interconnection Co.,Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise dedicated to the production and distribution of a diverse array of electronic components. Its extensive portfolio includes flexible printed circuit boards (FPCBs) and their associated assemblies, various types of electronic wiring, specialized electronic distribution reels, rigid-flex composite boards, custom wire harnesses, and LED light modules specifically designed for automotive use. Established in 1969, the company maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
